title: Herb
wikitext:
In [[World of Warcraft]], '''herb''' can mean one of two things: #A leaf [[Item|item]] or part of and plant that serves as an [[Ingredient|ingredient]] for use with a [[Professions|profession]] (usually [[Alchemy]]). Sometimes a [[Quest]] item. #A plant [[Resource|resource]] that those with the [[Herbalism]] [[Professions|profession]] can [[Harvest|harvest]] to gain the above item or items.
